propDocs.HoverCard.disabled: Disables the preview while retaining the trigger link.
propDocs.HoverCard.delay: Milliseconds before a hovered or focused link opens its preview.
propDocs.HoverCard.closeDelay: Milliseconds before leaving the link and card closes the preview.
propDocs.HoverCardContent.side: Preferred side; collision handling may flip the card.
propDocs.HoverCardContent.align: Aligns the card to the start, center or end of the link.
propDocs.HoverCardContent.sideOffset: Gap in pixels between the link and card.
propDocs.HoverCardContent.alignOffset: Offset in pixels along the alignment axis.
